author: Nerdstalgic
description:
That ’70s Show was constantly changing...and not always because it wanted to.

For eight seasons, the series became one of television’s most beloved sitcoms by building an unforgettable group of characters around Eric, Donna, Kelso, Jackie, Hyde, and Fez. But as the show evolved, some of those characters were changed, replaced, or pushed in completely different directions.

From Donna Pinciotti’s increasingly frustrating character arc, to Topher Grace’s departure as Eric Forman and the disastrous attempt to replace him with Randy, That ’70s Show spent its final seasons trying to fix problems that threatened the heart of the series. Even the show’s finale attempted to repair some of the damage by bringing the original cast back together and returning to what made the series work in the first place.
